caption: The drawing is a monochromatic technical illustration executed in pencil on a beige background. At the center, there is a detailed, shaded front view of a rounded, vertically symmetrical container with a wide base, narrow neck, and bulbous middle, topped by a domed, perforated lid with a small finial at its peak. The lid is marked with evenly spaced holes. Around the central image, there are two smaller line drawings: on the lower left is a top view of the container's lid showing the arrangement of holes in a circular pattern with additional annotations, and on the lower right is a scaled-down side view of the container with vertical and horizontal measurements. At the bottom center, there is a labeled scale. The composition is presented within ruled boxes and guidelines, emphasizing mechanical precision. All elements are rendered in shades of gray pencil, and the background is free of additional ornamentation.
title: Salt Shaker
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
